subject: Request: Interim Assurance / Bridge Statement to Cover Post-Audit Period
messages:
From: Sophie Lang <sophie.lang@altitudebiotech.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Altitude Biotech Procurement <procurement@altitudebiotech.com>
Date: 2026-11-15T09:32:00-08:00
Subject: SOC 2 Type II + interim assurance/bridge statement request

Hi Laura,

Thanks for the quick intro last week. We're finalizing our vendor security checklist for an upcoming procurement review and need two items from Redwood before we move forward: your most recent SOC 2 Type II report (coverage period requested below) and an interim assurance / bridge statement that attests controls remain in place between the report end date and today.

Details:
- Requested SOC 2 period: 2025-01-01 to 2025-06-30 (we were told that is your last issued Type II)
- Bridge coverage needed: 2025-07-01 through 2026-11-15 (our vendor timeline requires current-day coverage)

Can you confirm whether you can provide a signed bridge letter and, if possible, a draft we can include in our procurement packet? Also let us know any standard limitations you include (e.g., scope, controls excluded, known exceptions) so we can assess.

Procurement timeline: we need final docs by 2026-11-24 to keep our approval cadence. If you need a PO or MSSA before sharing, call that out.

Thanks — appreciate a short reply with next steps, contact for legal/compliance, and estimated delivery.

Best,
Sophie Lang
Senior Sourcing Manager
Altitude Biotech
[Attachment: Altitude_Risk_Form.xlsx (spreadsheet)]

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Sophie Lang <sophie.lang@altitudebiotech.com>
Cc: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-15T11:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 Type II + interim assurance/bridge statement request

Hi Sophie — thanks for the clear note and timeline.

Short answer: yes, we can provide the SOC 2 Type II report and a bridge letter that attests to controls continuity for the requested post-audit period. A few quick things to set expectations:

- Our issued SOC 2 Type II report covers 2025-01-01 through 2025-06-30 (PDF attached).
- The bridge letter we provide is a management assertion that there have been no material changes to the control environment affecting the agreed scope since the report date; it is not an attestation by the auditor. If you need auditor-issued interim attestation, we can discuss timing and cost.
- Standard exclusions: short-lived maintenance windows, emergency patching events with documented change control, and any third-party subservice provider changes noted in the SOC appendix. We will highlight these in the draft.

Next steps from our side: Rafael (compliance) will prepare a draft bridge letter and Monica (legal) will review required language for procurement. We typically share a redlineable Word draft + a signed PDF. We can target 2026-11-18 for the draft and 2026-11-23 for the signed version, pending PO/contract triggers.

Please confirm whether Altitude requires a signed NDA prior to sending the SOC report (we normally require a simple NDA for full SOC reports), or whether procurement is comfortable with the SOC delivered under an existing MSSA. Also confirm the name/email for your legal contact for signature routing if a PO or DocuSign is needed.

Attached: Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_2025.pdf (redacted version), 

Thanks — Laura
Laura Bennett
Head of Customer Trust, Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com
[Attachment: Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_2025.pdf (PDF, redacted version)]

From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Sophie Lang <sophie.lang@altitudebiotech.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-17T08:47:00-08:00
Subject: Draft bridge letter + questions on scope

Hi Sophie / Laura — looping in a short draft and a couple clarifying questions.

Attached is a draft bridge-letter template we've used for similar customers; it is framed as a management assertion and references controls in the SOC 2 report by control family. Key points for Altitude to confirm so we tailor it correctly:

1) Scope: Do you need the bridge to call out all Trust Services Criteria we covered in the SOC (Security, Availability, Confidentiality) or only Security and Availability?
2) Timebox: You asked 2025-07-01 through 2026-11-15 — please confirm the 'as-of' date we should use on the signed letter (we generally use the date the letter is signed).
3) Auditor language: Are you expecting any auditor involvement or signature? Our standard is management-only bridge letters; we can note auditor involvement if you have a contractual requirement.

We'll redline language around change-of-control and third parties. If you confirm scope 1) and the as-of date, we'll push a signed PDF to you within one business day of receiving the PO / confirmation that no additional legal routing is required.

Attachments: bridge-letter-draft-altitudebiotech.docx

— Rafael
Rafael Mendes
Security & Compliance Manager
redwood.com
[Attachment: bridge-letter-draft-altitudebiotech.docx (Word)]

From: Sophie Lang <sophie.lang@altitudebiotech.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-19T15:08:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Draft bridge letter + questions on scope

Hi Rafael / Laura — thanks for the fast turnaround and the draft.

Responses:
1) Scope: Security + Availability are sufficient for our review team; we don't need Confidentiality called out explicitly in the bridge language.
2) As-of date: please use 2026-11-23 as the effective 'as-of' date in the signed bridge letter (that aligns with our approval cadence).
3) Auditor involvement: not required — we accept a management assertion for procurement.

Procurement confirms we can accept the SOC under the existing MSSA (no additional NDA). We will not require a PO to receive the draft, but we will need a signed PDF for our packet on 2026-11-23. Please send the signed PDF to procurement@altitudebiotech.com and copy me.

If possible, can you call out in the letter any control changes since 2025-06-30 that were temporary and fully mitigated? We can mark them as acceptable in our review with mitigation evidence.

Appreciate the help — Sophie
Sophie Lang
Senior Sourcing Manager
Altitude Biotech
[Procurement timeline: final docs by 2026-11-24]
